    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    ptr = 0
    t = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[ptr])
        m = int(input[ptr + 1])
        ptr += 2
        grid = [list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr + m])) for _ in range(n)]
        ptr += m * n
        bad_cols = set()
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(1, m):
                if grid[i][j] < grid[i][j - 1]:
                    bad_cols.add(j - 1)
                    bad_cols.add(j)
        if len(bad_cols) == 0:
            results.append("1 1")
        elif len(bad_cols) > 2:
            results.append("-1")
        else:
            bad_cols = list(bad_cols)
            if len(bad_cols) == 1:
                bad_cols.append(bad_cols[0])
            col1, col2 = bad_cols
            for i in range(n):
                grid[i][col1], grid[i][col2] = grid[i][col2], grid[i][col1]
            good = True
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(1, m):
                    if grid[i][j] < grid[i][j - 1]:
                        good = False
                        break
                if not good:
                    break
            if good:
                results.append(f"{col1 + 1} {col2 + 1}")
            else:
                results.append("-1")
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
